theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), W ⊆ U → T.massOn W < ∞ → T.boundary.massOn W < ∞ → ∀ f : Eucl P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ W → ∀ L : Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl (m + 1), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ a : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → ∀ M : ℝ, (∀ y, |a y| ≤ M) → ∀ φ : TestFormOn U (m + 1), (∀ x, (φ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) x = (f x * a (L x)) • wedgeCovectors (m + 1) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj i : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp L)) → |T φ| ≤ C * M * ((volume (tsupport a)).toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / ((m : ℝ) + 1))
